verdict.rationale: Reflect documents search filters by date created/updated, daily notes, backlinks, #tags and pinned status. That is an adjacent search feature, not querying user-defined structured properties. Nothing in the evidence shows live database-style views such as tables, boards or lists generated from queries.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can query my notes by their structured properties and render live database-style views (tables, boards, lists) from those queries
